minutes.headline: Planning Board endorsed the Northfield ANR and approved the 260 Falula Road stormwater permit and site plan.
minutes.summary: The board endorsed an ANR plan on Northfield Road, closed the Falula Road hearing and approved the warehouse stormwater permit and site plan with draft-decision conditions. It reviewed the 88 Mass Ave decision, received the draft master plan RFP (deferred to the next meeting for a deeper review), and discussed sewer and zoning, committee reports, and donation bins at Walmart.

votes.outcome: passed 3-0 by roll call (Reed aye, Brenner aye, chair aye)

budget_items.what_was_said: The regional transportation committee reported that state grant money is available to towns, with Ayer given as an example.

decisions.decision: Construction hours for Falula Road were set at 7 to 5 Monday to Friday and 8 to 3 Saturday, with any later mismatch with Fitchburg's hours to be handled by a de minimis change.
The 88 Mass Ave written decision was accepted as drafted, with no motion needed; members will sign it.
The master plan RFP review was deferred to the next meeting so members can read it more closely. The RFP is aimed at the Central Register in December.
The Municipal Building committee appointment was tabled and moved to board discussion along with the environmental policies.
Driveway regulations were tabled until spring town meeting preparation.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted 3-0 to endorse the ANR plan for the Northfield Road lots.
The board closed the 260 Falula Road hearing, then voted 3-0 to approve the stormwater permit and site plan with the conditions in the draft decision.
Construction hours for the Falula Road site were set, with any later mismatch with Fitchburg's hours to be handled as a de minimis change.
Review of the draft master plan RFP was deferred to the next meeting so members can read it more closely.
Driveway regulations and the Municipal Building committee appointment were both tabled.

why_it_matters: The Falula Road approval clears a warehouse project to proceed under set stormwater conditions and work hours, which bears on neighbors and on traffic and drainage on that road.
The master plan RFP is the document that would start the town's planning work, and its price and scope were not settled at this meeting, so the timetable depends on the next meeting.
watch_next: The master plan RFP review at the next Planning Board meeting; the minutes say it is aimed at the Central Register in December.
The tabled driveway regulations, which the minutes say wait until spring town meeting preparation.

They differ on the Northfield ANR lots (A, B and C against Lot A and Outlot B), and on a vote to close the Falula Road hearing that appears only in our minutes.
